id: title:Gilbert09:handle empty report windows without crashing the sync

review.posthog_relevance: Changes the response streaming mechanism for warehouse report ingestion, replacing `TextIOWrapper` with a buffered stream wrapper to prevent connection closure and potential `ValueError` on empty bodies.
review.reason: The chunk demonstrates a substantive, bounded implementation of a new response streaming class (`_ResponseByteStream`) and its integration into the warehouse report ingestion path. P1.F1.H3 introduces the class definition, while P1.F1.H4 replaces the previous `TextIOWrapper` implementation with a `BufferedReader` wrapping this new stream. P1.F2.H2 and P1.F2.H3 update the test setup

The complete behavior and validation of the new stream-wrapping implementation are not fully visible in this chunk.
